digest.component_or_area: G7 plan-review criterion routing and rubric
propositions: G7 routing is flipped from advisory@0.95 to blocking with block_threshold 0.85 so G7 findings can block in plan-review Pass-3.

Kind scoping relies on existing plan-v4 divergence grading: contradicts_reality and omits_required_site hard-floor impact at 0.85 while incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55 and never reaches the blocking bar.
Per-grade Pass-3 gating restricting blocking to contradicts_reality alone is rejected because it needs new cross-gate machinery and the FP evidence is kind-blind.
An unresolvable parent must abstain with a covered-but-unverified note rather than emit a finding (fail-open).
A closed parent is checked against its final as-closed state and scope handed to sibling tickets is not a leaf violation.
At most one finding is emitted per contradicted parent clause, folding additional manifestations into that finding's evidence (rubric-only dedup).
